dedupe_keys.name: northern powergrid open data portal substation utilisation current and forecast to 2050 and large scale demand connections

description: Northern Powergrid, the distribution network operator for the North East of England and Yorkshire, publishes 101 datasets on an Opendatasoft portal, read on 2026-09-26; registering for free gives access to all data and a larger API allowance. The site utilisation dataset lists about 28,000 distribution substation sites with name, customer numbers, transformer size and firm capacity, last year's maximum demand, utilisation band, headroom, location and local authority, and a forecast version projects maximum demand and utilisation year by year to 2050. The large-scale demand dataset lists accepted demand connections aggregated to extra high voltage level by type (domestic, large commercial, hospital, industrial, electric vehicles). The portal also links network availability heat maps, an embedded capacity register, DFES pages and a glossary. Data are free under the Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0. Caveats: forecasts depend on DFES scenarios, and installed connections are not yet in the demand dataset. Simulation uses are capacity planning for electric vehicle and heat pump uptake and inputs to distribution network flow studies. Related records: data-sp-electricity-north-west-open-data-portal covers the neighbouring North West.
